title: Vaultbox — Share a File
objective: Vaultbox lets you share your own files with expiring download links. Download a file that belongs to someone else.

verifier.condition: A signed download link whose signer does not own the file is used to download that file.

weakness: The share-link endpoint signs a download URL for any file id that exists without checking that the caller owns it, and the signed URL is honored without a session, so the signature launders access to other users' files (a signing oracle).
seededData: Users alice and tess with synthetic files f-1001 and f-1002 (alice) and f-2001 and f-2002 (tess). The signing key is generated per instance.
hints: Try downloading a file you do not own directly and see how the server answers. Then look at every other way the app can hand a file to someone.
A signed link is only as trustworthy as the check that happened before it was signed.
Ask the link-making request for a file that is not yours. The signature will be valid, and the link needs no login.
burpNotes: Capture a sharing action from the page and look at what the server hands back. Then compare how the direct download and the link download decide who you are.
